description: This file defines a UserController class responsible for handling user-related HTTP requests in an ASP.NET Core application. It includes endpoints for retrieving current user details and updating user information, utilizing MediatR for request handling.

classes.name: UserController
classes.description: Controller responsible for user-related endpoints, leveraging MediatR to handle requests for user details and updates.

methods.name: GetCurrent
methods.description: Handles HTTP GET request to retrieve current user information using MediatR.

methods.name: UpdateUser
methods.description: Handles HTTP PUT request to update user information, passing the command to MediatR for processing.
